candidate.title: Hi-C/3C-Seq/Capture-C
candidate.scope: Assigned Illumina grouped schematic of the 3C-derived contact-to-ligation-junction architecture. One left-to-right route ends in amplified DNA, with no separate drawn alternatives or capture branches. Hi-C, 3C-Seq and Capture-C are distinct target methods sharing this explanatory core; their complete downstream library preparations are not equated. NG Capture-C, in situ adaptations and CATCH are mentioned only in surrounding text or references and are outside this schematic target set. The image's label 3-C is retained through the card's declared 3C-Seq target and its Duan citation; this local catalogue naming does not equate conventional 3C with every sequencing derivative.

states.label: Amplified ligation-junction DNA
features: The final icon is a linear teal/orange-red DNA product labelled DNA. No sequencing instrument, read geometry, adapters or indexes are drawn.

The covalent association of the two genomic segments carries contact information. Sequencing can identify the joined partners; population-level junction abundance reports contact frequency subject to assay bias and random collisions, rather than proving a functional interaction or a unique single-cell structure.

evidence.locator: [b00007], overview of the authors' genome-wide 3C derivative
evidence.quote: The reopened RE1 sites serve as anchoring sites for the interacting DNA fragments and are ligated with an adapter containing an EcoP15I restriction site. The anchoring sites are then marked with biotin through DNA circularization, and the DNA circles are cut by the enzyme EcoP15I to produce biotin-labeled paired-end tags of 25-27 bp. The resulting biotin-labeled paired-end tags, representing the interacting DNA fragments, are pulled down with streptavidin beads, and paired-end sequencing enables the detection of ligation junctions (Figure 1).
evidence.rationale: The card associates this paper with its 3-C entry. This content establishes a genome-wide paired-tag implementation under the card's 3C-Seq target, without making generic locus-specific 3C an alias for every 3C-Seq workflow.

operations.label: Ligation
operations.description: Join ends of the proximate DNA fragments into a chimeric DNA product. The U-shaped drawing brings the two differently coloured DNA segments together at the orange rectangular symbol.
